summary: No reachable security issues. PlayingCard/CardBack render only constant path data, colours and geometry from card-art.ts; the only caller-supplied value is `card`, which formatCard range-checks (throws RangeError) before any use, and `deck` is a typed union indexing a constant table. All attributes go through React's escaping; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML or eval anywhere in src/ or the new e2e files. The logo is a same-origin Vite asset import (src/assets/tlh-logo.jpg) bound to <image href>, not user-controlled, and no external URLs or fonts are introduced. The gallery helper (e2e/support/card-gallery-bundle.ts) builds in memory (write: false, configFile: false) from a fixed entry resolved relative to the module, injects it with page.setContent/addScriptTag, and opens no ports, writes no temp files and needs no cleanup. Nothing test-only reaches production: card-gallery.tsx is referenced only by the e2e helper, nothing in src/ or index.html imports e2e/, and the production build entry is unchanged. No new dependencies.
